Completed chunks keep their biomes and blocks. Chunks still being generated may use the new regions when they finish, and new chunks beside old ones may differ in surface, decoration and structures. The choice is saved in the world.

sunrise.extras.agent_control.tooltip: Your own AI agent can play this game through sunrise-ctl or an MCP client, on this computer only.
sunrise.extras.chat_animation.tooltip: A new chat line slides in from the left while it fades in, instead of appearing whole.
sunrise.extras.chat_indicator.tooltip: The coloured bar at the left of a chat line.
sunrise.extras.dynamic_lights.tooltip: Torches and other light sources held, dropped or on fire light the blocks around them.
sunrise.extras.fullbright.tooltip: Show blocks and entities at full light, even in dark areas.
sunrise.extras.hide_block_particles.tool: Hides the debris particles that burst from a broken block and crumble off the one you mine. Other particles stay.
sunrise.extras.mouse_tweaks.tooltip: Right-drag places one per slot, left-drag gathers the held item, Shift + left-drag moves every slot.
sunrise.extras.mouse_tweaks_wheel.toolti: Down sends one item of the slot to the other side, up brings one back.
sunrise.extras.music_page.tooltip: Music & Sounds gets a Music... page: play any built-in track now, or turn one off so the game stops picking it. Nothing changes until you turn a track off.
sunrise.extras.no_ai.tooltip: Hides and turns off every AI feature: agent control, sunrise-ctl and the MCP servers. The launcher's switch too.
sunrise.extras.own_name_tag.tooltip: Shows your name above your head in third person, as other players see it. Hidden when the server hides your team's names or you're invisible.
sunrise.extras.pack_browser.tooltip: Select Resource Packs gets an Add button that searches Modrinth and installs a pack into your packs folder. Off, the game never contacts Modrinth.
sunrise.extras.pregen.tooltip: Enables /pregen in your single-player and LAN worlds. With cheats enabled, use /pregen start to generate an area before exploring it. Does not enable the command on servers you join.
sunrise.extras.repro_keys.tooltip: F3+R starts or stops a repro recording and F3+E writes its bundle. Off by default: a recording copies the world.
sunrise.extras.sort.tooltip: Sorts the inventory, chests, barrels, ender chests and shulker boxes in creative tab order, merging stacks.
sunrise.extras.sort_key.tooltip: Sorts the part under the cursor. Click, then press a key; Escape unbinds it.
sunrise.extras.shader_pack_key.tooltip: Turns the picked shader pack off and on. Click, then press a key; Escape unbinds it. The pick is remembered across restarts.
sunrise.extras.ui_sound_reserve.tooltip: Sounds in the world leave 16 of the 247 sound channels free, so a flood of them (a big explosion) can't silence menu clicks.
sunrise.extras.wheel_cycles_list_setting: The scroll wheel over a button in a settings list changes its value. Off, as in vanilla, the wheel scrolls the list.
sunrise.friends.code_ready: Your invite code is ready: Game Menu, Play with Friends. Copy it and send it to your friends.

sunrise.friends.hint: Friends paste the code after the title screen's Friends button, in Direct Connection, or on the launcher's Play page.
sunrise.friends.relay_stopped: Too many wrong short codes, so the relay is off until you share again. Friends can still join with the full code.
sunrise.friends.share_intro: Share this world behind an invite code: it opens to LAN, and friends on the internet join with the code. No server of ours is involved.
sunrise.friends.short_code_changed: Someone kept trying a wrong short code, so it changed.
sunrise.friends.title: Play with Friends

sunrise.options.radial_mode.about: Hold the opener for the radial menu, or press it once to open it and again to close it.
sunrise.options.radial_mode.hold.about: Hold the opener and let go to run what the stick points at.
sunrise.options.radial_mode.toggle.about: Press the opener to open it; A or the opener again runs what the stick points at, B closes it.
sunrise.options.radial_stick.about: The stick that points at the radial menu's slots.
sunrise.options.radial_stick.either.abou: The last stick pushed points; neither walks nor turns the view. Only a bumper, a trigger or View can open the menu.
sunrise.options.radial_stick.left.about: The left stick points and you stand still. D-pad Right is under that thumb: pick an opener on the Radial Menu page.
sunrise.options.radial_stick.right.about: The right stick points at the slots; the left still walks.
sunrise.options.renderDistance.memory: At this distance chunk meshes can take up to about %s GB of memory, in RAM or graphics memory. For long views, set 32 to 48 and turn on LOD Distance: far terrain costs far less.

sunrise.pvp.chat_compact.tooltip: A message repeated in a row shows once, with how many times it came: (x3).
sunrise.pvp.chat_copy.tooltip: Clicking a message in the open chat copies its text, unless the click does something else.
sunrise.pvp.chat_search.tooltip: Ctrl+F in the open chat: what you type shows only the messages holding it. Enter or Ctrl+F again stops.
sunrise.pvp.chat_timestamps.tooltip: The time each message came in, before it.

sunrise.pvp.clear_water.tooltip: Under water, see as far as vanilla lets you after 30 seconds there, from the start.
sunrise.pvp.combat_feel.tooltip: Legacy draws fights as 1.8.9 did: the item in your hand, its swing, eating, the bow and a sword held up while you hold use, without the dip after each hit or the attack indicator. Only the look: what you send a server stays the same.
sunrise.pvp.combat_indicator.tooltip: Keeps the attack indicator under Legacy, which 1.8.9 didn't have.
sunrise.pvp.combat_sounds.tooltip: Under Legacy, leaves out the attack sounds 1.9 added (strong, weak, sweep, critical...). Hurt sounds stay.

sunrise.pvp.crosshair_colour.tooltip: Inverted shows the colour under it inverted, as vanilla's crosshair does.
sunrise.pvp.crosshair_dot.tooltip: A dot in the middle of the crosshair.
sunrise.pvp.crosshair_gap.tooltip: The empty space in the middle.
sunrise.pvp.crosshair_hover.tooltip: Another colour while the crosshair is over a mob or a player you could hit, as vanilla's attack indicator knows it.
sunrise.pvp.crosshair_outline.tooltip: A thin black edge, so it shows on any background.
sunrise.pvp.crosshair_shape.tooltip: A cross, a T, an X, a circle, a square or only a dot.
sunrise.pvp.crosshair_size.tooltip: The length of each arm, in GUI pixels.
sunrise.pvp.editor.hint: Drag widgets · Wheel: size · Right click: back to its corner
sunrise.pvp.editor.tooltip: Move the widgets on the game: drag them anywhere, resize them with the wheel, right click one to put it back in its corner.
sunrise.pvp.fire_lower.tooltip: Moves the flames you see while burning down, so they cover less of the screen.
sunrise.pvp.glint_colour.tooltip: The colour of the shimmer on enchanted items and armour. Off is vanilla's purple.
sunrise.pvp.hit.tooltip: Changes the colour mobs and players flash when they are hurt. Red at 30% is vanilla's.
sunrise.pvp.hit_colour.tooltip: The colour hurt mobs and players flash.
sunrise.pvp.hit_opacity.tooltip: How much of the colour covers them.
sunrise.pvp.hud_armour.tooltip: The armour you wear, head first, with how many uses each piece has left.
sunrise.pvp.hud_armour_percent.tooltip: Uses left as a percent of the piece's maximum instead of a number.
sunrise.pvp.hud_background.tooltip: A dark box behind each widget.
sunrise.pvp.hud_combo.tooltip: Hits in a row the server confirmed, until you are hurt or 3 seconds pass without one.
sunrise.pvp.hud_coords.tooltip: Your block position and the direction you face, as F3 shows them. Hidden when the world or server reduces F3.
sunrise.pvp.hud_cps.tooltip: Your left and right clicks in the last second.
sunrise.pvp.hud_cps_corner.tooltip: Where the clicks per second show.
sunrise.pvp.hud_editor_key.tooltip: Opens the HUD editor from the game. Click, then press a key; Escape unbinds it.
sunrise.pvp.hud_effects.tooltip: Your effects with their names, levels and time left, in place of the icons at the top right.
sunrise.pvp.hud_fps.tooltip: Frames drawn in the last second.
sunrise.pvp.hud_held.tooltip: How many of the item in your hand your inventory holds; arrows with a bow or crossbow.
sunrise.pvp.hud_keys.tooltip: Your movement keys, mouse buttons and jump, lit while you hold them, with clicks per second.
sunrise.pvp.hud_opacity.tooltip: How dark the boxes behind the widgets are.
sunrise.pvp.hud_ping.tooltip: The latency the server reports for you, in milliseconds. Multiplayer only.
sunrise.pvp.hud_reach.tooltip: How far from your eyes your last hit landed, for 3 seconds. It only measures: your reach stays vanilla's.
sunrise.pvp.hud_server.tooltip: The address of the server you play on. Multiplayer only.
sunrise.pvp.hud_shadow.tooltip: A shadow under the widgets' text, as vanilla's HUD text has.
sunrise.pvp.hud_speed.tooltip: How fast you move across the ground, in blocks per second.
sunrise.pvp.hud_text_colour.tooltip: The widgets' text colour. Durability keeps its green to red.
sunrise.pvp.numeric_enchants.tooltip: Tooltips and the enchanting table show Sharpness 5 instead of Sharpness V.
sunrise.pvp.outline.tooltip: Changes the outline around the block you look at.
sunrise.pvp.outline_colour.tooltip: The outline's colour. Black at 40% is vanilla's.
sunrise.pvp.outline_fill.tooltip: Tints the faces of the block you look at, lightly.
sunrise.pvp.outline_thickness.tooltip: The outline's width, in times vanilla's.
sunrise.pvp.preset.tooltip: Turns on the custom crosshair, the armour and effects widgets, toggle sprint and sneak, lower fire, and the FPS counter and keystrokes mods if installed. Your settings for each stay.
sunrise.pvp.shield_size.tooltip: The size of the shield in your hand, in first person.
sunrise.pvp.totem_size.tooltip: The size of the totem that fills the screen when it saves you.
sunrise.pvp.view_time.tooltip: The time of day you see: the sky and its light only. The world's time goes on and nothing is sent to the server.
sunrise.pvp.view_weather.tooltip: The weather you see: rain, its light and fog only. The world's weather goes on and nothing is sent to the server.
sunrise.radial.conflict: Shared with another action: in play the menu takes that button. Press to pick another.
sunrise.radial.delete_page.about: Removes this page and its slots at once. Undo brings it back.
sunrise.radial.delete_page.last: The menu keeps at least one page.
sunrise.radial.missing.about: This game doesn't know the action %s: the slot keeps it and runs nothing. Press or Right to put another here.
sunrise.radial.new_page.about: Adds an empty page after the last one, and shows it.
sunrise.radial.new_page.full: The menu holds at most %s pages.
sunrise.radial.opener.about: The button held to open the menu. Press, then press the controller button to use: a bumper or the D-pad, not A, B, X, Y or the right stick, which steer and cancel.
sunrise.radial.opener.about.either: The button held to open the menu. Press, then press the controller button to use: a bumper, a trigger or View; both thumbs steer, and B cancels.
sunrise.radial.opener.about.left: The button held to open the menu. Press, then press the controller button to use: a bumper, A, X or Y, not the D-pad or the left stick, which steer, nor B, which cancels.
sunrise.radial.page_of: Page %s of %s. Each slot is a direction of the selecting stick while the opener is held.
sunrise.radial.pick.about: Puts this action in the slot and goes back. The slot's own is marked.
sunrise.radial.rename.about: Give this page a name of your own.
sunrise.radial.reset.about: Puts back the General and Camera pages and removes the rest, at once. Undo brings them back.
sunrise.radial.reset.default: The pages are the defaults already.
sunrise.radial.slot.about: The action this direction runs. Press it for the list of actions, Right for the next one, Left or Shift-click for the one before.
sunrise.radial.unbound: No button opens the menu (one under the thumb that selects is let go): press, then press a controller button.
sunrise.radial.why.quick_actions: This server has no Quick Actions
sunrise.realms.not_signed_in: Sign in with your Microsoft account in the Sunrise launcher to play on Realms.
sunrise.recipe_transfer.unavailable: Recipe does not fit this menu
sunrise.recipes.fuel.options: Hold SHIFT to pin this tooltip, then click an ingredient to view recipes.
sunrise.repro.no_recording: There is no recording to export yet.
sunrise.repro.started: Recording started; F3+R stops it and writes the bundle.
sunrise.settings.pack_options.none: None of the selected resource packs has options.
sunrise.settings.shader_options.none: This pack has no settings to show.
sunrise.settings.tab.extras.about: PvP & HUD, and the settings pages mods add.
sunrise.settings.tab.resource_pack_optio: Options of the selected resource packs that have some.
sunrise.settings.tab.tools.about: Replay Studio and the AI agent.
sunrise.shaders.unsupported: Shader pack %s uses a format that is no longer supported, so it is not used
sunrise.shaders.modOff: Shader pack %s is off because its mod is off
sunrise.controller.notice.controller_dis: Reconnect it, or press a button on another
sunrise.studio.empty: No recordings found in the recordings folder.
sunrise.studio.empty_hint: Use /studio record start <name> in a world, or drop .mcpr files there.
sunrise.studio.freecam.enabled: Studio free camera enabled. Use WASD to move, Space and Shift to rise or descend, and Control to move faster.
sunrise.studio.freecam.replay_required: Studio free camera is available during replay playback
sunrise.studio.freecam.unavailable: Studio free camera could not find a player camera
sunrise.studio.keyframe.added: Camera keyframe added at %s ms. The path is saved when you close the replay.
sunrise.studio.keyframe.cleared: Camera path cleared. The change is saved when you close the replay.
sunrise.studio.keyframe.index_invalid: Camera keyframe index is out of range
sunrise.studio.keyframe.removed: Removed camera keyframe %s. The change is saved when you close the replay.
sunrise.studio.path.usage: Usage: /studio path <lock|unlock> (add at least one keyframe first)
sunrise.studio.record.status.active: Studio recording active — %s s, %s packets, %s KB (%s)
sunrise.studio.replay.seek.backward_requ: Rewind is only available for a standalone replay.
sunrise.studio.replay.seeked: Studio replay seeked to %s ms (%s s)
sunrise.studio.replay.status: Studio replay: %s / %s ms (%s%%), speed %s×, paused %s, finished %s
sunrise.studio.topbar.title: ✦ Studio
sunrise.title.not_affiliated: Not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft
